item.title: Flydubai cockpit attack: Israel to honour Capt Smit with top civilian bravery award
item.description: Israel has announced that Captain Smit Machchhar will receive a prestigious Presidential Award for his bravery. He prevented a potential aviation disaster aboard Flydubai flight FZ1073 by acting decisively against a radicalized co-pilot. During the incident, six Israeli passengers displayed great courage in assisting Machchhar and foiling the hijack attempt. This heroic act has led to a broader investigation into the circumstances of the attack.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Nana Patekar death: Goa Police register 'unnatural death' case
item.description: Nana Patekar passed away due to a cardiac arrest at his residence in Goa early Thursday morning. He was declared dead after attempts to revive him were unsuccessful at Manipal Hospital. The Goa Police have registered an 'Unnatural Death' case to investigate the circumstances surrounding his death. A post-mortem examination is being conducted to ascertain the exact cause of death.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: IAF celebrates its 94-year-old glorious journey
item.description: Indian Air Force celebrated its 94th anniversary at Hindon Air Force Station showcasing its historical significance. The event featured aerobatics by the vintage Tiger Moth and a display of military aircraft. IAF Chief ACM Singh emphasized the importance of operational preparedness and joint operations with the Army and Navy. PM Narendra Modi and Defence Minister Rajnath Singh commended the courage and dedication of IAF personnel.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: GST Council scraps tax officers' arrest powers, eases refund rules
item.description: The GST Council has proposed major procedural changes to enhance business operations and tax compliance. These reforms aim to streamline registration, refunds, and input tax credit processes while lowering compliance costs. Additionally, the council will remove officers' powers for arrests under the GST framework. Processing of refunds will be expedited, with a goal to resolve claims within three days.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Will those whose earnings have stopped love me: PM Modi amid SIR row
item.description: PM Narendra Modi called for a global effort to address cyber frauds and deepfakes at the India Mobile Congress. He highlighted the importance of mobile technology as a tool for governance and effective service delivery. Modi attributed significant financial savings to digital direct benefit transfers in India. He urged collaboration among governments and tech companies to enhance security measures in the telecom sector.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: US suspends Microsoft from Green Card programme, here is what the company has to say
item.description: The US has suspended Microsoft from the Permanent Labor Certification Program (PERM), freezing new and pending Green Card applications for its foreign workers. Vice President JD Vance accused Microsoft of abusing the H-1B and PERM system to replace laid-off American workers. Microsoft says 80% of its roughly 6,000 H-1B filings last fiscal year were for existing employees, and that it pays H-1B staff the same as others doing comparable work.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Nana Patekar cremated with full state honours, fans bid tearful farewell
item.description: The Indian film industry mourns the loss of Nana Patekar, who succumbed to cardiac arrest as confirmed by his son. The actor's passing, attributed to natural causes, prompted the Maharashtra government to orchestrate a state funeral fitting his legacy in cinema. Tributes poured in from fans and fellow actors in Pune, with many sharing their fond memories of the beloved artist on social media.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: Woman claims 2.5 acres was ancestral after stepmother sold it; why HC rejected plea
item.description: The Madras High Court held that the property was not ancestral but self-acquired. As a result, under Hindu law, the man and his mother were legally entitled to execute the gift settlement deed in favour of the man’s second wife, who could subsequently sell the property.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: ‘Reckless’ use of NSA has made it ordinary: MP HC
item.description: Madhya Pradesh high court quashed the preventive detention of two brothers under the National Security Act. The court criticized the reckless invocation of the Act by authorities and highlighted a lack of evidence. It found the brothers had been acquitted in multiple cases where NSA was applied, asserting non-application of mind. The court underscored the need for constitutional safeguards against arbitrary detentions.
item.dc:creator: ASHUTOSH SHUKLA

item.title: AI use ups homework scores, but slashes exam marks: Study
item.description: World Bank's report reveals that unrestricted use of generative AI may enhance homework scores while diminishing actual learning outcomes. Evidence indicates that students using AI showed improvement in assignments but performed worse in exams over time. Concerns exist regarding students outsourcing their learning process to AI rather than engaging in cognitive effort. However, AI used by teachers to customize instruction shows promising learning gains.
item.dc:creator: MANASH PRATIM GOHAIN

item.title: Sandra Bullock’s 91-acre California ranch with 1,200 avocado trees sells for $5.6m
item.description: In 2007, Sandra Bullock acquired a sprawling 91-acre ranch in Valley Center for $2.725 million. After transforming it with extensive renovations and establishing an organic avocado farm, she sold the property for $5.6 million in 2024. Encompassing a beautifully refurbished adobe house, a guest cottage, and facilities for agricultural operations, the ranch stands as a perfect blend of luxury and sustainability for its future owner.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Bryan Cranston rebuilt $2.5m bungalow as net-zero home, sold it for $5.45m
item.description: Bryan Cranston transformed a quaint beach bungalow into a stunning net-zero energy residence in Venice, California. The redesigned home showcases sleek modern aesthetics paired with cutting-edge sustainable energy solutions, reflecting eco-conscious principles. Listed in 2021, it achieved an impressive sale of $5.45 million, exceeding its initial purchase price. This remarkable project exemplifies the potential of sustainable living within today’s competitive real estate landscape.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Priscilla Chan founded a school; 10 years later, Board votes to close it
item.description: Priscilla Chan's Primary School in California, which aimed to support low-income families, has closed. The school shut down due to funding issues after receiving significant financial support over ten years. It was noted that academic results were mixed, and some features resembled a startup environment. Around 540 children were enrolled prior to the closure, affecting many local families.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Zach Bryan bought $18m Tennessee estate on 146 acres with recording studio
item.description: Earlier this year, Zach Bryan made headlines by purchasing a sprawling estate in Leiper's Fork, Tennessee, valued at $18.25 million. This stunning property boasts nearly 40 acres of breathtaking views and luxury amenities, including a professional recording studio tailored for his music career. It showcases Bryan's desire for privacy, while still being conveniently located near the vibrant Nashville music scene.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: KPSC scam candidates taken to resorts, provided with Q&A: ED
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate reported on a significant corruption case involving the Karnataka Public Service Commission. Candidates for the veterinary officers' exam were allegedly bribed to receive leaked test papers before the exam. An organized syndicate was involved in the manipulation of the recruitment process, leading to multiple arrests of officials. Investigations revealed a systematic approach to generating proceeds of crime through examination material leaks.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Bypoll election results: When and where to watch vote counting
item.description: Votes for five Assembly constituencies and the Nagaon Lok Sabha seat will be counted today. Counting will commence at 8am, with results announced throughout the day. Updates will be provided by the Election Commission of India on their official results website. The Times of India will also provide live coverage of the counting process and results. The counting will occur under security arrangements at the respective counting centres.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Donna Kelce’s cookie fundraiser: How did she raise $4,100 for students?
item.description: Travis Kelce’s mom Donna Kelce helped turn her famous family cookie recipe into a charity fundraiser for Kansas schoolchildren. After small-business owner Annie Stowe received permission to print the recipe on handmade mugs, $5 from each sale went towards paying elementary school lunch debt. The mugs initially raised $2,000 in 2023, followed by another $2,100 after local coverage, bringing the total to $4,100.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Connor McDavid’s wife Lauren Kyle: How did she build her five-venture empire?
item.description: Lauren Kyle McDavid's entrepreneurial journey blossomed with her interior design firm, Kyle & Co. However, she initially struggled with the business side of her creativity. To support her, her husband, Connor McDavid, arranged sessions with a business coach. By June 2025, Lauren broadened her horizons, introducing projects like Sports Club Atelier and Trove Living, all while striving to craft meaningful experiences in her diverse portfolio.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: US sanctions Indian firms, individuals as Iran oil crackdown widens
item.description: On Thursday, the United States targeted two Mumbai-based companies over their alleged oil trade involvement with Iran. The sanctions affected five Indian nationals connected to SSPL Solutions Private Limited and Samudra Marine Services Private Limited. These measures are part of a broader crackdown on Iran under 'Operation Economic Outcast'. The U.S. government aims to curb Iranian oil revenues fueling military and cyber activities.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Group of 42 ex-judges defends SIR, slams opposition attack on Election Commission
item.description: A group of 42 retired judges has expressed concerns over criticism directed at the Election Commission. They stated these attacks serve vested political interests, compromising democratic integrity. The judges defended the EC's actions as essential to maintaining clean electoral rolls for fair elections. They urged political parties to present legit grievances formally, rather than delegitimizing the electoral process.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Jharkhand should 'revisit' DGP appointment rules, says Supreme Court
item.description: The Supreme Court stated that the appointment process for Jharkhand's DGP likely violated its previous judgment regarding officer tenure. The court issued a notice to Tadasha Singh, appointed shortly before her retirement. The Central Government argued that Jharkhand's amended regulations overstepped the Supreme Court's mandate on DGP appointments. Jharkhand, represented by Kapil Sibal, criticized the selective enforcement of these regulations by the Centre.
item.dc:creator: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA

item.title: IPS quota in CAPF posts comes into force
item.description: The Central Armed Police Forces (General Administration) Act, 2026, has come into effect on October 8. This Act mandates that senior posts in CAPFs be filled by IPS officers on deputation. The government supports this move for better coordination between the Centre and states. CAPF cadre officers express concerns regarding career advancement due to this new quota.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Proof of 21 'compromised transfers', 11 policy changes part of CBI's Punjab file
item.description: CBI has obtained evidence related to compromised transfers involving 21 senior officials in Punjab government and police. The probe focuses on a cash-for-postings scam connected to OSD to Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann. Allegations include various requests for administrative favors and transfer requests surrounding certain officers. The investigation involves interactions with individuals linked to tender manipulations across the state.
item.dc:creator: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA

item.title: Starlink entry row: Is Ambani the real boss of India, asks Elon Musk
item.description: Elon Musk has raised concerns about regulatory obstacles facing Starlink's introduction in India. He claimed influential figures might be hindering the process and questioned if Ambani controls the situation. In response, India's government reaffirmed its fair and non-discriminatory approach, rejecting Musk's allegations. Other companies like Reliance Jio and Eutelsat OneWeb are also vying for approval to offer satellite services.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH SINHA

item.title: J&K: High court orders passport revival for student purusing MBBS in Iran
item.description: Ibra Khan, a student pursuing MBBS at Tehran University, had her passport impounded due to her father's past case. The Jammu & Kashmir High Court intervened, recognizing her completion of half the course before the impounding occurred. Legal representatives argued that Khan could not be held accountable for her father's actions from 1997. A division bench ordered the passport's revival while allowing authorities to impose conditions on its use.
item.dc:creator: NASEER GANAI

item.title: Cancer drug prices may fall as government plans 30% trade margin cap
item.description: The Indian government has announced plans to cap trade margins on all types of cancer drugs. This decision aims to make cancer medications more affordable and accessible, potentially reducing prices by up to 70%. It is expected to result in savings of around Rs 2,500 crore annually for patients. An expert committee will be formed to recommend the list of drugs covered by this initiative.
item.dc:creator: RUPALI MUKHERJEE

item.title: Defence secy talks to German envoy & Greece dy min to widen strategic partnerships
item.description: Newly appointed German Ambassador Jasper Wieck met with Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh to discuss defense cooperation. India and Germany aim to strengthen their military and defense-industrial ties, including advanced technologies. The talk follows high-level engagements and a recent agreement on co-development of defense items. Meanwhile, India engages with Greece on maritime security and coastal protection issues.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: 'Contest UP polls from Ayodhya': Akhilesh Yadav dares CM Yogi Adityanath
item.description: Akhilesh Yadav has urged Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath to contest the upcoming assembly elections from Ayodhya. He indicated plans to visit the Ram temple alongside SP leaders after visiting Kedareshwar Dham in Etawah. Yadav also noted that the BJP has been conducting surveys for the Ayodhya seat, claiming they are struggling to find a candidate to challenge him. This statement responds to BJP allegations about his temple visitations.
item.dc:creator: PALLAVI

item.title: 'Welcome to India': Rahul reacts to Musk's remarks; Starlink boss says 'thank you'
item.description: Rahul Gandhi has weighed in on Elon Musk's comments about the hold-up of Starlink's commercial operations in India. Musk voiced his exasperation over regulatory obstacles, suggesting that oligarchs sway the industry. The government swiftly countered, emphasising the fairness of its regulations among satellite operators and underlining the importance of security compliance for safeguarding users and data alike.
item.dc:creator: PALLAVI

item.title: 'Unite to fight': Uddhav Sena to Kejriwal, Stalin; will AAP, DMK relent?
item.description: Uddhav Thackeray's Shiv Sena has called on AAP and DMK to join opposition forces against CEC Gyanesh Kumar over irregularities in SIR. Despite AAP's separation from the INDIA bloc and DMK's mixed reactions, the lack of participation from both factions underscores existing rifts in the opposition landscape. Analysts argue that these parties might still rally together to uphold democratic principles, though future collaboration remains clouded by their historical rivalries.
item.dc:creator: KUNAL VARMA

item.title: CJP claims Deepak Baliyan assaulted, brother injured; Rajasthan Police deny action
item.description: The Cockroach Janata Party reported that their co-incharge, Deepak Baliyan, was detained by Rajasthan Police. This incident occurred ahead of the planned protest in Delhi against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. While party leaders accused police of forceful detention, the police denied such claims. Protests against Kumar have also been held in Bengaluru by various activists and groups.
item.dc:creator: RAJENDRA SHARMA

item.title: 5 injured after gas cylinder explodes at workers’ shed on IIT Bombay campus
item.description: A significant incident unfolded on Thursday night when a gas cylinder exploded in a workers' shed at an under-construction building on the IIT Powai campus. Occurring at approximately 10:24 PM in Hostel No. 6, five people sustained injuries—two minors and three adults. Fortunately, all individuals are reported to be in stable condition.
item.dc:creator: RICHA PINTO

item.title: Indians among hundreds to get share of $35m payout in labour 'exploitation' case
item.description: In a significant development, over 100 construction workers are about to be compensated in a settlement linked to Caddell Construction due to allegations of labor exploitation at the new US consulate in Milan. Workers endured illegal wage cutbacks, unpaid overtime, and deplorable working environments. Expected payouts will average near 45,000 euros, with select cases reaching an impressive 90,000 euros.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: Ratan Tata’s beloved pet dog 'Goa' survives car accident outside Bombay House
item.description: Ratan Tata's pet dog Goa was injured in a car accident outside Bombay House on Thursday. After being given medical attention, Goa is reportedly recovering and shows signs of improvement. Noel Tata visited the injured dog to check on his wellbeing during this time. Goa is expected to participate in the Blessing of Pets ceremony on Sunday, October 11.
item.dc:creator: BELLA JAISINGHANI

item.title: Bihar: Masked man removes jewellery from dead body, calmly walks away
item.description: A viral video raises security concerns after a man allegedly removed a chain from a deceased body. The incident occurred at Siwan Model Sadar Hospital, where he approached the body near the registration counter. Following a similar previous complaint, security access to deceased patients is now under scrutiny. Hospital authorities are planning to examine the footage and take legal action if necessary.
item.dc:creator: KSHITIZ
